title: An unset bare variable renders as literal {key} in text, but stays 0 in a condition
why: The documented typo signal: missing data has to be VISIBLE on screen rather than quietly reading as 0. The two halves are easy to conflate — the browser player rendered 0 in text, which hides the typo, while ink defaults must still hold inside conditions. Both halves are asserted here so a runtime cannot fix one by breaking the other.
